name: @wildflowerhealthio/code-index-web
description: The code index at `wildflowerhealth.io/code-index`: for each package, its files and top-level items with their doc comments, a what-uses-what graph, and the simplification hints those uses imply. `scripts/extract.ts` reads Rust from rust-analyzer's SCIP index and TypeScript from the TypeScript checker; `scripts/build-page.ts` inlines the data into `viewer/template.html`.
